The change is a return-code split, not a semantic one: project_pr returns 2 for every publish-confirmed conclusion and 1 only when no check was published. The push loop aggregates only 1, so a green main push run means the adapter published for every open PR, not that every open PR is dispositioned - recorded as durable semantics on #4837.

The readiness gate is not weakened: pull_request and merge_group keep `|| overall=1` and still fail on either code, and publish() plus its arguments are untouched, so the per-PR published state is byte-identical for the same inputs.

The fix does not close the root. The structural cause is the disposition binding base_sha, so every landing stales every open PR; #4834 and the stale-base rebind treadmill share it, and the structural fix (merge_base + diff_digest instead of base_sha) is post-checkpoint.
Rebase note: the head moved from 2dab2c9bf to 20ca9d00a only to clear a head-specific merge-queue admission refusal; the content diff is unchanged and the reviewer verified that independently.
